findings.mechanism: The focus growth and success carriers meet the HFT-attributed forenoon-food and pre-dawn-meal roles, turning increase into an image of replenishment at the right rhythm.
findings.reader_payoff: Cultivation gains a sustaining image in which discipline is fed rather than understood only as deprivation.
findings.containment: The pre-dawn meal and forenoon food are remote, attributed contextual images; the focus forms do not mean eating, and the reading remains exploratory.

epistemic.reason: The outlier trace is exact and returns to the focus, but both the food-related contextual role and its contact are legacy_unbound and remote.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Oruçtan önce şafak vaktinde yenilen öğünün özel adı.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus success form carries the exact special name for a pre-dawn meal that supports continuance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT trace supplies the daily-cycle food role at 91:1 word 2.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Self-cultivation can exploratorily be perceived as replenishing the strength by which growth continues.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not mean a meal or fasting practice; this is an attributed outlier analogy.

findings.title: A win tested against its appearance
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus certifies a success that must produce real rectitude and growth rather than a victory manufactured by deceptive appearance.
findings.mechanism: The focus purity and deception facets meet the HFT-attributed gambling victory and explicit falsehood coordinates, making the focus success an anti-counterfeit distinction.
findings.reader_payoff: The emphatic success claim becomes newly perceptible as certification of a durable good, not any visible win.
findings.containment: The deception facet is qualified and the gambling and falsehood roles are attributed; this is an exploratory contextual shadow, not an alternate translation of أَفْلَحَ.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace preserves the focus return and context coordinates, but its remote deception facet and unresolved context roles require exploratory qualification.
